headline: Nairobi Securities Exchange to Extend Trading Hours to 4 PM in 2027
summary: The Nairobi Securities Exchange announced it will extend daily trading hours by one hour, allowing investors to trade until 4 PM starting January 2027.
why: Extended trading hours aim to increase market liquidity and trading activity on Kenya's primary bourse.

impacts.name: Nairobi Securities Exchange All Share Index
impacts.why: Longer trading hours provide expanded execution windows for market participants.
